fact: Niger's national meteorological directorate (DMN) runs a live satellite imagery page serving EUMETView/Meteosat products (Natural Colour Enhanced RGB, GEO/LEO-blended precipitation rate, Dust RGB for dust-storm monitoring).
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Niger among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
